hypothesis: A frozen V2 HEAD plus content-bound overlay can reproduce identical source in three isolated worktrees without changing protected assets.
paper_claim: Infrastructure prerequisite only; no scientific benefit claimed.
falsifier: Any source digest mismatch, original protected asset drift, ownership overlap or wrong Git history.
targeted_tests: manifest equality across source and worktrees
cost_cap: No paid dispatch or native solve in baseline stage; 3 source trees < 1 GB plus <= 2 GB bounded pilot artifact reservation. Existing cumulative authorization retained.
claim_boundary: Reproducible engineering state only. Original Baseline/Demo/ten Pi sessions and UNKNOWN retained.
stop_condition: Source drift, mismatch, less than 5 GB available or ambiguous repository history stops dispatch.
